data.name: Thad
data.description:
Thad has lime neon eyes in his visor and appears to have a metallic gelled hair style. He wears a hat that has a red top bordered with orange, and underneath his hat is what seems to be blonde hair. His shirt consists of a black vest that has a deleted square icon printed onto it while wearing a dark yellow green shirt underneath.

Thad is shown to be unlike the other Worker Drones, as he is brave and even dares to stand out and fight off the Murder Drones, even though he knew that it would risk his life. His personality also closely resembles a high school jock, though he is nicer, presumably more than his friends.
